title: Narrow versus wide transformations
summary: Classify transformations by whether data must move across partitions.

blocks.text: Classify transformations by whether data must move across partitions.

items: Narrow transformations can compute an output partition from a small number of input partitions.
Wide transformations such as groupBy or many joins generally require a shuffle.
Shuffles cost network, serialization, disk and scheduling time.
Avoiding every shuffle is not the goal; making necessary shuffles efficient is.
